name: Skinning rack
examine: Pegs, hooks and a lot of old stains. For basin wildlife.

name: Lye vat
examine: A glazed vat of lye. Scalth creatures come apart in it without taking your hands with them.

name: Synod strongbox
examine: Iron, red paint and the seal of the Sanguine Synod. Whatever goes in is recorded in a ledger somewhere.

name: Apothecary's still
examine: Copper coils under the counter, warm to the touch. Not the kind of thing an honest apothecary owns.

actions.label: Distil
actions.lockedMessage: That's Corvin's, and it's behind his counter. Perhaps ask him about it.

name: Waystone
examine: A mossy marker stone on Palmerway, cut with the Synod's drop of blood.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: CRUOR, ELEVEN DAYS EAST. TOLLING, AN HOUR WEST. Under the second line someone has scratched a small bell.

name: Waygate
examine: A wardens' gate in the palisade, sealed with Synod wax. The road to Cruor runs on beyond it.

actions.label: Open
actions.lockedMessage: Barred from the far side. A notice under the seal reads: THE ROAD TO CRUOR IS CLOSED UNTIL THE CAUSEWAY IS MENDED. BY ORDER OF THE WARDENS.

name: Cruorian monument
examine: A red stone needle on a stepped plinth, raised by Cruor where the road leaves Tolling. Its founts are cut into the steps.

actions.label: Read
actions.message: THE BLOOD OF THE MANY IS THE KEEPING OF THE BAY. GIVE, AND BE KEPT. Below, in smaller letters: Raised in the forty-first year of the Keeping, by the faithful of Palmerway.

name: Fount
examine: A bowl cut into the monument's step, ringed with little bronze teeth. It is never quite dry.

node.startMessage: You push your arm into the fount. The teeth close, and it drinks.
node.depletedMessage: The fount is sated. Another will wake.

surge.message: One of the monument's founts wakes hungry.
